claim: In high-throughput mode, the default throughput of an SQS FIFO queue in all other AWS Regions (those not listed separately) is 2,400 TPS.
question: SQS FIFO high-throughput mode: the maximum transactions per second in all other Regions?

values.spoken: two thousand four hundred transactions per second

qualifiers.scope: per queue; non-batched API calls; all other AWS Regions; high throughput mode
